g.title: n1
g.text: Fixed scripts, cron jobs, folder watchers,
Shortcuts. No model. The path never changes.
Tool layer: the script or Shortcut itself
Loop: none (a scheduler may retrigger it)
Stop condition: none (or the schedule ends)
The steps are fully known and should run

g.title: n2
g.text: The model fills in values or wording inside
Inference layer: one shot per fill-in step
Loop: none (the path is the sequence)
Stop condition: the end of your path
The sequence is fixed, but some steps need

g.title: n3
g.text: The model chooses among tools and steps
you defined, looping until the goal is met.
Inference layer: repeated calls in a loop
Tool layer: the tools you registered
Loop: yes, until the goal is met
Stop condition: goal met, or a
You know the allowed tools, but not the

g.title: n4
g.text: The model invents steps you never listed,
Inference layer: repeated calls in a loop
You cannot list every step in advance, but
you can bound the work with rules

g.title: special
g.text: Also consider — these can combine with
an agentic workflow (3) or an autonomous agent (4)

g.title: n5
g.text: A GUI layer such as PyAutoGUI
Inference layer: one call per look-act step
Stop condition: task done, or a max-action limit
The app has no usable API and must be

g.title: n6
g.text: One model generating multiple turns or roles
that critique each other before acting.
Inference layer: one call per role or turn
Tool layer: optional, same tools as
Stop condition: agreement, a reviewer verdict,
You want a second viewpoint, a reviewer,
or a debate before something is executed.

g.title: n7
g.text: A graph of solved sequences that get reused
when the same kind of task appears again.
Model: yes (to match or write a skill)
Inference layer: used to select or
Tool layer: saved skills plus ordinary tools
The same solved sequence will be needed again,
so it should not be rediscovered from scratch.

g.title: cycle
g.text: 1. Model emits a structured tool call
2. Harness validates and runs the tool
3. Result is fed back into the context window
4. Model decides: another call, or stop
then loops back to step 1 until it stops
